# Fiverse Systems Inc. — Full Technical Context & System Documentation

**Website**: https://fiversesystems.com  
**Contact**: hi@fiversesystems.com  
**Headquarters**: San Francisco, CA / Remote Global  
**Leadership**: Satyajit Nikam (Founder & Principal AI Architect)  

---

## 1. Company Overview & Mission
Fiverse Systems is an AI-first software development and digital product engineering company. We transform complex workflows, proprietary enterprise data, and foundation AI models into reliable, high-throughput production software. Our team delivers enterprise-grade AI agents, scalable RAG architectures, custom software, and multi-tenant SaaS platforms in fixed 6 to 8-week production sprints.

## 2. Quantitative Performance Benchmarks & SLAs
- **Production Uptime SLA**: 99.98% availability guarantee on deployed AI microservices and cloud infrastructure.
- **LLM Inference Latency**: Sub-800ms Time-to-First-Token (TTFT) via optimized vLLM and TensorRT-LLM runtimes.
- **Data Retrieval Precision**: 94.6% top-3 retrieval accuracy using Hybrid Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) with Cross-Encoder re-ranking.
- **Workflow Efficiency Gains**: 40% to 65% reduction in manual operational and customer support ticket handling times.
- **Security Compliance**: SOC2 Type II aligned, HIPAA compliant architecture pipelines, and zero-data-retention private cloud VPC deployments.
- **Development Sprint Velocity**: 6–8 weeks from initial requirements discovery to live production deployment.

## 3. Core Technical Specializations & Stack

### A. Agentic AI & Autonomous Multi-Agent Swarms
- **Frameworks**: LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, custom deterministic finite state machines.
- **Orchestration Mechanics**: Planning nodes, dynamic tool routing, schema-validated JSON outputs, sandboxed code execution, token budget governors, and human-in-the-loop escalation gates.
- **Key Use Cases**: Autonomous sales prospecting, customer support resolution, document intelligence parsing, DevOps automation, financial reconciliations.

### B. Enterprise RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
- **Vector Stores**: Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, Weaviate, pgvector.
- **Search Mechanics**: Dense embedding retrieval (OpenAI `text-embedding-3`, BGE, Cohere), sparse keyword indexing (BM25), Hybrid RRF search, and contextual reranking (Cohere Rerank v3).
- **Chunking & Ingestion**: Semantic chunking, tabular data extraction from PDFs/DOCX/XLSX, metadata-augmented indexing.

### C. Private LLM Deployment & Domain Fine-Tuning
- **Open-Source Foundations**: Llama 3.3 (70B, 8B), Mistral (Large, Nemo), Qwen 2.5, DeepSeek-V3.
- **Serving Engines**: vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Ollama, TGI on AWS EC2 (A10G, H100) and GCP TPU/GPU clusters.
- **Fine-Tuning Techniques**: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT), LoRA, QLoRA, Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF).

### D. Full-Stack Custom Software & Cloud SaaS
- **Backend Architecture**: Python (FastAPI, Django), TypeScript (Node.js), Go, Rust.
- **Frontend Architecture**: React 19, Next.js, Vite, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, React Native, Flutter.
- **Database & Messaging**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, ClickHouse.
- **Cloud & DevOps**: AWS (ECS, EKS, SageMaker, Lambda), Google Cloud (GKE, Vertex AI), Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, GitHub Actions CI/CD.

## 4. Proprietary Product: Fiverse Workplace Platform
- **URL**: https://fiversesystems.com/workplace-platform
- **Overview**: Intelligent hybrid workplace coordination platform featuring real-time interactive desk booking, automated team presence notifications, and bidirectional HR integrations (Slack, Microsoft Teams, BambooHR, Gusto, Workday, HiBob).

## 5. Engagement Models & Delivery Framework
1. **AI MVP Sprint (6–8 Weeks)**: Fixed-cost, rapid turn-around production build designed for funded startups and innovative enterprise units.
2. **Dedicated AI Engineering Pod**: Embedded cross-functional pod (Lead AI Architect, Senior Full-Stack Engineers, ML Engineers, UI/UX Designer) operating on dedicated retainers.
3. **Enterprise Architecture Modernization**: Phased migration of legacy monolithic applications into modern, AI-integrated microservices.
